custom_steps:
1. In the Location menu, untick location B.
  2. Copy the page address.
  3. Reload the page.
  4. In the Location menu, click "Select all".
  5. In the Location menu, untick location B again. Open Sales By Customer (Reports, then "Sales By Customer" under PERFORMANCE in the left menu), then click the browser's Back button. (QA lead ruling, 11 Nov 2026: Back restores the filters when it brings you back to the report, as on Sales By Customer; Back straight after a filter change leaves the report.)
  6. Open a new browser tab.
  7. Paste the copied address into its address bar.
  8. Press Enter.
